iWantTo: view a SKU detail page showing its stock across all locations including the tracking code
soThat: I can see the full picture for a SKU in one place

independence.rationale: S2 delivers the home-screen location table; S3 delivers a separate per-SKU detail view with cross-location stock, tracking codes, and a par-level 'not tracked' state. Building S2 fully leaves the SKU detail view entirely unbuilt.
